**Note 1:** This schema is based on the UICC chapter *Lung,* pages 138-146.
* Primary sites C348 and C349 are listed in the chapter heading but are not specified in the anatomic subsites in this chapter of the UICC manual; however, they are included in this schema and TNM staged if appropriate histology criteria are met

**Note 2:**  Laterality must be coded for this site (except carina).

**Note 3:** In addition to directly assigning TNM, Summary Stage 2000 (SS2000) must be captured.  If directly assigning SS2000, use the *Lung* chapter on page 154 of the [SS2000 on-line manual](https://seer.cancer.gov/tools/ssm/ssm2000/SSSM2000-122012.pdf#page=154).
